description: This Python source file defines the 'BudgetManager' class, which manages user budgets for a project, including creation, updates, cost tracking, and data persistence. It interacts with local files and external services to load and save budget data and includes utility methods for projected costs and cost resets based on durations.

classes.name: BudgetManager
classes.description: Class for managing user budgets, costs, and durations within a project, supporting local and hosted data storage.

methods.description: Prints verbose logs if verbosity is enabled in litellm.

methods.description: Loads budget data either from a local JSON file or from a remote server.

methods.description: Creates a new budget for a user with optional duration and timestamp.

methods.name: projected_cost(self, model: str, messages: list, user: str)
methods.description: Calculates the projected cost of a message exchange based on model tokens and current user cost.

methods.name: get_total_budget(self, user: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the total budget allocated to a user.

methods.name: get_current_cost(self, user)
methods.description: Returns the current accumulated cost for a user.

methods.name: get_model_cost(self, user)
methods.description: Returns the accumulated model-specific costs for a user.

methods.name: bool is_valid_user(self, user: str)
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the budget data.

methods.name: get_users(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all users with budget data.

methods.name: reset_cost(self, user)
methods.description: Resets the current cost and model costs for a user.

methods.name: reset_on_duration(self, user: str)
methods.description: Resets a user's budget if the specified duration has elapsed since last update.

methods.name: update_budget_all_users(self)
methods.description: Updates and potentially resets budgets for all users based on duration.

methods.name: _save_data_thread(self)
methods.description: Saves data asynchronously in a separate thread.

methods.name: save_data(self)
methods.description: Persists the user budget data either locally or to a remote server.
